Merchant City

Tron Theatre

Housed in a beautiful converted church at the heart of the Merchant City, the Tron is Glasgow’s home for new writing and independent theatre. With an intimate main stage and a buzzing bar, it programmes a mix of Scottish premieres, visiting companies, and its popular scratch series for works-in-development.
